levels.description:
Consumes <@ba.vdown>10</> DP to fuse sword and staff, gaining <@ba.vup>increased</> Attack Range, <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> ATK, and attacking up to <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target:0}</> targets simultaneously; 
When skill is active, can spend <@ba.vdown>15</> DP to activate <$ba.alter>Equipment Alteration</>, extending skill duration by <@ba.vup>15</> seconds
